original.target_description: Roelofs et al. (2010), Facing Freeze; original full text could not be acquired through public routes. No original statistics extracted from the replication paper.

replication.target_description: Replication study 1 measured heart rate only; target body-sway relationship was not measured. The heart-rate block ANOVA is not the body-sway test.

notes: Replication p. 1891 (PDF p. 2): "First, we focused on heart rate and did not include a measure of body sway." Supplied replication locator p. 3 contains heart-rate analyses, not the target body-sway outcome. No analytic n, effect size, or p attributed to a nonexistent body-sway replication test. Original acquisition failure details are in texts/03c1fec331b10ea539fdbd6d.miss.
